title: Pancakes
hookLine: United States-inspired pancakes with 7 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Pancakes
steps.instructionTemplate: Put the flour, eggs, milk, 1 tbsp oil and a pinch of salt into a bowl or large jug, then whisk to a smooth batter. Set aside for 30 mins to rest if you have time, or start cooking straight away. Incorporate {m52854_1}, {m52854_2}, {m52854_3}, and {m52854_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure flour first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Pancakes
steps.instructionTemplate: Set a medium frying pan or crêpe pan over a medium heat and carefully wipe it with some oiled kitchen paper. When hot, cook your pancakes for 1 min on each side until golden, keeping them warm in a low oven as you go.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Pancakes
steps.instructionTemplate: Serve with lemon wedges and sugar, or your favourite filling. Once cold, you can layer the pancakes between baking parchment, then wrap in cling film and freeze for up to 2 months.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Glaze or toss in sugar while still warm so the coating melts lightly and clings to every ridge.

steps.title: Drain Crisp, Toss & Serve Fresh
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer to the wire rack to drain excess oil for 1–2 minutes while still piping hot, then finish with {m52854_5}, {m52854_6}, and {m52854_7}. Serve Pancakes fresh while the exterior is shatteringly crisp.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 33 mins!
